raw_content:
Commercial real estate lending rates, autumn 2026

Average rates on new commercial real estate loans eased to 6.4% in 2026, down from 6.9% in 2025. Senior loans on stabilised office and logistics assets priced near 6.1% in 2026.

Banks returned to the market in the second half of the year, while debt funds kept the largest share of transitional loans.

This fictional report was prepared for a software demonstration.
